counting_method: Page-aware pdftotext extraction with inclusive page ranges, excluded start headings, and exclusive end headings. ASCII words are counted after line-break hyphen repair. Equations, captions, and plot labels are excluded where line patterns identify them. All counts remain mechanical drafts until visual reconciliation.
ambiguities: The introduction and rigid-body baseline share page 2; heading-bounded segments preserve their separate functions.
Simulation results, parameter sensitivity, and alternative-bat model improvements overlap physically but are recorded as distinct rhetorical functions.
Equation-heavy pages 3-8 and 13 can fragment extracted prose and require visual paragraph review.
Page 15 contains references only and is excluded from the technical denominator.
